# =============================================================================
# CMakeLists.txt - AUTO-GENERATED by FreeRTOS_AzureImport.sh - do not hand-edit.
#
# Wires together the individual FreeRTOS components shipped in this release.
# Every add_subdirectory() below points at upstream's own CMakeLists.txt - the
# resulting targets (freertos_kernel, freertos_plus_tcp, sigv4, ...) are
# upstream's, not invented here. The kernel is always added; every other
# component is OFF by default.
#
# The project-side FreeRTOS configuration lives in the handler module folder
# of the same name next to ThirdParty/ (e.g. Middlewares/FreeRTOS):
#   FreeRTOSConfig.h      kernel configuration header
#   FreeRTOSConfig.cmake  freertos_config target, FREERTOS_PORT, FREERTOS_HEAP
#                         and any FREERTOS_ENABLE_<COMPONENT> switch
# Both are seeded from this release's templates the first time the project
# is configured and never overwritten afterwards. The folder can be changed
# with the FREERTOS_CONFIG_DIR cache variable.
#
# This folder must be processed BEFORE the modules linking freertos_kernel,
# e.g.:
#   target_link_libraries(FreeRTOS_Lib PUBLIC freertos_kernel)
#
# Components that ship only a *FilePaths.cmake (no CMakeLists.txt of their
# own) are listed below as a comment naming the exact *FilePaths.cmake to
# include() - it only sets *_SOURCES / *_INCLUDE_PUBLIC_DIRS variables, the
# add_library() is up to the project.
# =============================================================================

#======================== Project configuration seeding =======================#

# Middlewares/ThirdParty/FreeRTOS -> Middlewares/FreeRTOS
get_filename_component(FREERTOS_WRAPPER_NAME "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" NAME)
get_filename_component(FREERTOS_THIRDPARTY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" DIRECTORY)
get_filename_component(FREERTOS_MIDDLEWARES_DIR "${FREERTOS_THIRDPARTY_DIR}" DIRECTORY)

set(FREERTOS_CONFIG_DIR "${FREERTOS_MIDDLEWARES_DIR}/${FREERTOS_WRAPPER_NAME}" CACHE PATH
    "Folder holding the project's FreeRTOSConfig.h and FreeRTOSConfig.cmake")

set(FREERTOS_CONFIG_HEADER "${FREERTOS_CONFIG_DIR}/FreeRTOSConfig.h")
set(FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE  "${FREERTOS_CONFIG_DIR}/FreeRTOSConfig.cmake")

message(STATUS "FreeRTOS: project configuration folder ${FREERTOS_CONFIG_DIR}")

# Each file is seeded on its own - a missing one is added, an existing one
# is never overwritten.
foreach(FREERTOS_SEED_FILE IN ITEMS "${FREERTOS_CONFIG_HEADER}" "${FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE}")
    get_filename_component(FREERTOS_SEED_NAME "${FREERTOS_SEED_FILE}" NAME)
    set(FREERTOS_SEED_TEMPLATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${FREERTOS_SEED_NAME}.template")

    if(NOT EXISTS "${FREERTOS_SEED_FILE}" AND EXISTS "${FREERTOS_SEED_TEMPLATE}")
        configure_file("${FREERTOS_SEED_TEMPLATE}" "${FREERTOS_SEED_FILE}" COPYONLY)
        message(STATUS "FreeRTOS: seeded ${FREERTOS_SEED_FILE} - edit it for your target.")
    endif()
endforeach()

#=========================== Project configuration ============================#

if(NOT EXISTS "${FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "FreeRTOS: ${FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE} not found and could not be seeded (template ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/FreeRTOSConfig.cmake.template missing).")
endif()

include("${FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE}")

if(NOT TARGET freertos_config)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "FreeRTOS: ${FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE} must define the 'freertos_config' INTERFACE library exposing FreeRTOSConfig.h.")
endif()

if("${FREERTOS_PORT}" STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "FreeRTOS: FREERTOS_PORT is not set - set it in ${FREERTOS_CONFIG_CMAKE} (e.g. GCC_ARM_CM4F, GCC_ARM_CM7, GCC_ARM_CM33_NTZ_NONSECURE - examples listed in that file).")
endif()

message(STATUS "FreeRTOS: port ${FREERTOS_PORT}, heap '${FREERTOS_HEAP}'")

#============================ Kernel and components ===========================#

add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/FreeRTOS/FreeRTOS/Source freertos-kernel)
